title: Lively's Brittany Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew originating from Brittany, featuring lentils and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the lentils, vegetable broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Check that the lentils are tender, then serve hot.
